newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banco de Mexico says banking recovery a challenge.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Mexico says banking recovery a challenge.

text.p: Banco de Mexico said on Tuesday that three important challenges in particular are facing Mexico, among them the full recovery of the banking system.

In its annual report for 1996, the central bank said that Mexico must combat the grinding poverty that affects a large part of the population, and face up to underemployment that often leads to unemployment.
It said the solution to underemployment is tied to deepening structural reforms.

"In respect to the recovery of the banking system, it should be kept in mind that an efficient and solid financial intermediation process is crucial to support high levels of eocnomic growth," the central bank said in its report.
